correctness.rationale: The normalized Weyl basis gives singular values sqrt(N)|A_z(u,v)| exactly. Support differences restrict u to weights 0,2,4; each class is evaluated explicitly, and the residual class is identically zero. Counting zero coefficients yields the additive rank formula; nonnegativity yields the exact maximizing parameter locus and an explicit seed. The dominant weight-four stratum proves the uniform two-atom empirical limit. Exact Gaussian-integer enumeration for 4<=n<=7 over seven parameter choices plus separately implemented direct complex projector-Gram eigenvalue tests at n=4 confirmed the formulas. No finite computation is mistaken for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The sparse even-Hamming-shell window is a canonical finite-group localization object with an intrinsic parity tomography obstruction. Its complete parameter rank discriminant distinguishes robustly improving phase choices from real-axis/vertical/circle resonances, and gives an attainable sharp information dimension. The universal two-point bulk law for arbitrary z_n is a structural property of this entire natural window family, not an isolated numerical table or incremental bound. The result specifies both what the window can recover linearly and the unavoidable blind directions, without claiming nonlinear phase retrieval.
